about.heading: About
about.lead: A product-minded full-stack profile able to move from business need to final experience.
about.statement: I build web products that must convince users and hold up in production.
about.text: Fullstack developer in a work-study program at 1UP, I started coding self-taught through The Odin Project before completing certified training at Simplon in web development and then application design. Currently pursuing a Master's in Software Engineering at ISCOD, I work daily on Odoo and Symfony projects. What I love about this field is the continuous problem-solving and the richness of the web — there's always something new to learn.
about.card1Desc: Two years of work-study experience at 1UP as a fullstack developer, working on Odoo and Symfony projects in real business conditions.
about.card2Desc: 5-month internship at the Grenoble Computer Science Laboratory, developing features for users in a research context.
about.card3Desc: Started self-taught through The Odin Project. The web is a rich and complex field where problem-solving never stops.

experience.heading: Experience
experience.subtext: A practice-built trajectory: self-learning, university research, business software, ERP, e-commerce, and showcase websites.

entries.title: Fullstack Developer — Work-Study
entries.description: Development and maintenance of Odoo modules (Python, PostgreSQL). Design and development of a B2B e-commerce site with Symfony. Corporate website redesign with Next.js. Solo management of Odoo v16 → v19 migration. Database administration, CI/CD and VPS server management (OVH, Digital Ocean).
responsibilities: Technical owner for internal Odoo business developments.
Autonomous management of the Odoo v16 → v19 ERP migration.
Fullstack development across ERP, B2B e-commerce, corporate website and infrastructure.

entries.title: Web Developer Intern — LIG Lab
entries.description: Development of a Vue.js and D3.js application for a sociological study questionnaire on life trajectories. Custom data visualization creation. Collaboration with university researchers.
responsibilities: Design and development of a first functional version of the application.
Implementation of D3.js visualizations tailored to research needs.
Translation of sociological needs into usable interfaces and data models.

entries.title: Computer Science Education
entries.company: ISCOD · Simplon · Université Savoie Mont Blanc
entries.description: Self-taught through The Odin Project, then certified training at Simplon: Web and Mobile Web Developer (RNCP level 5, 2024), Application Designer & Developer (RNCP level 6, 2025). Currently pursuing a Master's in Software Engineering (RNCP level 7) at ISCOD. TOEIC 920/990 (Listening C1, Reading B2).
entries.institutions: Simplon uses active pedagogy centered on learning by doing through projects inspired by real professional situations, in small groups of 15 to 25 learners. Founded in 2013, the organization has trained over 30,000 learners with 75% employment rate and 95% certification success. ISCOD offers state-recognized distance work-study programs, combining hands-on company experience with academic skill development.
responsibilities: Progressive construction of a fullstack web foundation, from self-learning to work-study.
Validation of professional skills through RNCP certifications and practical projects.
Consolidation of fundamentals in algorithms, design, databases and project management.
